summary: A search input for querying or filtering content.

alternatives.when: The user is entering general text rather than a search or filter query.

pitfalls: Keep value controlled and update it from onChange.
Provide either a visible label or aria-label so the search input has an accessible name.
End inputHint text with a full stop so screen readers pause before subsequent announcements.
If dropdown visibility depends on query length, use the same threshold for minQueryLength so screen-reader announcements match when results are displayed.
When using the suggestions dropdown, control open state and respond to onClose and onListItemSelect.

examples.description: Provide a visible label and punctuated hint text for an accessible search input.
Filter grouped suggestions and control the dropdown's open, close and selection state.
